Name: Jerevit's Services
Author: Rupnan
Description:
[quote][center][b][size=4]Jerevit's Services[/size][/b][/center]
[/quote]It's a mod that makes gift-giving and friendships much easier in Stardew Valley. By purchasing a membership through Jerevit, you'll receive an in-game mail in your inbox on the exact birthday of each villager with their most-loved gift ready to deliver. Please keep in mind that this service is seasonal: when the season changes, you'll need to renew your membership if you want to keep receiving gifts.
